records.title: Cluck and Moo loan approved
records.summary: Council approved a $25,000 forgivable loan for application ED2026-0005, with a public-purpose finding. Voigt moved and Lara seconded.
records.limit: Loan forgiveness, disbursement, operating milestones, and contract corrections require their own evidence.

records.title: Temporary Trevino skate amenities authorized for competitive bidding
records.summary: Council authorized competitive bidding, agreements and a purchase order up to $120,000. Funding is $72,609.98 in savings ($67,462.16 from P-09 and $5,147.82 from P-20) plus $47,390.02 from P27-01. The motion requires staff to bring back a budget adjustment reallocating the funding source. Voigt moved and White seconded.
records.limit: This is procurement authority, not a direct award to American Ramp or proof that a contract, installation, or funding-source adjustment has been completed.

records.title: Downtown Phase I design directed
records.summary: Council directed the City Manager to proceed with the Phase I concept as discussed and amend the STB Landscape Architects contract. Staff corrected the concept cost to $15,450; with $53,400 additional design services, the stated combined STB design cost is $68,850. Construction funding and a later award will return to Council.
records.evidenceLimit: The $2–3 million construction figure is a planning estimate, not an award or appropriation. Staff discussed existing downtown CIP resources and future funding options; no dedicated construction funding was authorized by this motion.

records.title: Later Stewart Park bid forecast
records.summary: During the Downtown discussion, staff forecast a Stewart Park bid going out by the end of 2026 and returning early in 2027. This is later than July’s anticipated late-September Phase II advertising.
records.limit: Transcript-based staff forecast, not a Council approval, issued solicitation or award. The remark does not expressly identify the phase or package; obtain the bid documents before treating it as a revised formal Phase II schedule. July’s Phase I March 2027 completion forecast is not independently refreshed by this remark.
